w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They settled names for 2 beasts: "Ugly-Eyes", "Old Gavel".

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rebecca just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Yuki telling the fire about Owen. "Owen came back mauled by Buffering (4 rounds, 55 taken) and alive. Three white lines across the forearm now." The story's already growing.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Ugly." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

★ IDENTIFIED: Ginkgo Nut. Ginkgo. Fan-shaped leaves, foul yellow fruit on the ground. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/11/7), with 5 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 5 · Craft 1 · Talk 17 · Explore 37 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Wei Chen ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Owen returns from the wilds hurt (health 3/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,050 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
